question: In a certain code language, “SPOT” is written as “POST”, and “PLOT” is written as “LOPT”. How will “SINK” be written in that language?
solution:
Here the pattern is:

The position of the last letter is same. But the 1st letter will go to 3rd position, 2nd letter will move to 1st position and 3rd letter will go to 2nd position.

“SPOT” is written as “POST”
